options.content: ● normal   ● warning   ● alarm   ● planned mode   ● bad data  ·  ⌀ 30-day average  ·  — not running  ·  No data = sensor silent for 5 min  ·  ● running ○ off  ·  ⓘ limits and definitions  ·  Tiles and cards show live values; charts follow the time picker.

panels.description: Running = permeate pump turning now. Relaxation = paused now but ran in the last 30 minutes (normal filtration cycle). Stopped = not run for 30 minutes.

targets.query: SELECT last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_frequency")*1000 + max("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_frequency") AS "state" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 30m

panels.title: MBR

panels.description: Running = RO high-pressure pump drive drawing more than 1 kW. (Uses drive power because the pump run signals are mislabelled; see punch list.) Works with both the old pump A drive tag and the new common drive tag (302_p_0102_ro_hp_pump_ab_power).

targets.query: SELECT last("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_power") AS "state" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m
SELECT last("302_p_0102_ro_hp_pump_ab_power") AS "state" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: RO

panels.description: Today (IST) from the RO permeate totalizer; on pace = average flow today × 24 h; ⌀ = average daily volume over the last 30 days.

targets.query: SELECT spread("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") AS "today" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0
SELECT mean("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow")*24 AS "↗ on pace" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter

SELECT mean(v) AS "⌀ 30 d" FROM (SELECT spread("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer") AS v FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 30d AND "302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m))

panels.title: RO permeate today

panels.description: Plant energy (MCC meter) per m³ of inlet flow, today (IST) and the 30-day average. Days with a meter reset are left out of the average.

targets.query: SELECT spread("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") / spread("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS "today" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0 AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0

SELECT mean(se) AS "⌀ 30 d" FROM (SELECT spread("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") / spread("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS se FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 30d AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0 AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m)) WHERE se < 50

panels.title: Specific energy

panels.description: MCC main meter: power now, and energy used today (IST).

targets.query: SELECT last("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_power") AS "now" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m
SELECT spread("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") AS "today" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0

panels.title: Plant power

panels.description: Number of equipment trip signals active now.

targets.query: SELECT last(/_trip_fb$/) FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: Alarms · trips

panels.description: Level switches active now: degasser sump low or high.

targets.query: SELECT last("302_lsl_01_dgsl_tank_level_low") + last("302_lsh_01_dgsl_tank_level_high") AS "warnings" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: Warnings

panels.description: Days since the last maintenance clean (alkaline and/or acid MC) recorded in the membrane cleaning log form.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_part('day', now() - max(c.cleaning_start_datetime)) AS "Days since last clean" FROM public.user_mbrcleaninglogandchemicalconsumptiondata c JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = c.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 396 AND c.cleaning_type IN ('Alkaline MC','Acid MC','Alkaline + Acid MC')

panels.title: Last membrane clean · MBR

panels.description: Time since the RO CIP pump last ran (run feedback 301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb). Looks back one year.

targets.query: SELECT last("301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb") AS "ran" FROM "plc" WHERE "301_p_02_ro_cip_pump_run_fb" = 1 AND time > now() - 365d

panels.title: Last clean · RO (CIP pump)

panels.description: Permeate flow, TMP and flux show — when the permeate pump is not running (relaxation or stopped). TMP is shown in mbar; the tag spec lists mm WC, to be confirmed with the PLC integrator.

targets.query: SELECT last("202_fit_01_mbr_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate flow", last("202_calc_mbr_tmp") AS "TMP", last("202_calc_mbr_flux") AS "Flux" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 3m AND "202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_frequency" > 0 GROUP BY time(3m) fill(null)

SELECT last("100_fit_01_inlet_flow") AS "Inlet flow", last("202_lit_01_mbr_tank_level") AS "MBR tank level", last("202_lit_02_permeate_tank_level") AS "Permeate tank level", last("201_ait_01_aeration_do") AS "Aeration DO", last("202_tit_01_mbr_outlet_temperature") AS "MBR outlet temperature" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: MBR

panels.description: Flows, recovery, pressures, permeate pH and TDS show — when the RO is not running. Bad data = outside the physical range (pH 0–14; pressures, flows and TDS not negative).

targets.query: SELECT last("302_fit_04_ro_feed_flow") AS "Feed flow", last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate flow", last("302_fit_01_ro_reject_flow") AS "Reject flow", last("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow") / last("302_fit_04_ro_feed_flow") * 100 AS "Recovery", last("302_pit_02_ro_hp_pump_outlet_pressure") AS "HP pump outlet", last("302_pit_01_ro_first_stage_outlet_pressure") AS "1st stage outlet", last("302_pit_03_ro_reject_pressure") AS "Reject pressure", last("302_calc_ro_first_stage_diff_pressure") AS "1st stage ΔP", last("302_calc_ro_second_stage_diff_pressure") AS "2nd stage ΔP", last("302_ait_04_ro_permeate_ph") AS "Permeate pH", last("302_ait_03_ro_permeate_tds") AS "Permeate TDS" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 3m AND ("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_power" > 1 OR "302_p_0102_ro_hp_pump_ab_power" > 1) GROUP BY time(3m) fill(null)

SELECT last("302_ait_01_ro_inlet_ph") AS "Inlet pH", last("302_ait_02_ro_inlet_orp") AS "Inlet ORP", last("302_xv_01_ro_recirculation_valve") AS "Recirculation valve", last("302_xv_02_ro_reject_valve") AS "Reject valve" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: RO

panels.description: MVRE has no live signals; its readings come from the daily forms.

targets.query: SELECT last("302_p_03_primary_ix_feed_pump_run_fb") AS "Primary IX feed pump", last("302_p_04_polishing_ix_feed_pump_run_fb") AS "Polishing IX feed pump", last("302_ait_05_wac_outlet_ph") AS "WAC outlet pH", last("302_b_01_degasser_blower_a_run_fb") AS "Degasser blower A", last("302_b_02_degasser_blower_b_run_fb") AS "Degasser blower B", last("302_lsl_01_dgsl_tank_level_low") AS "Degasser sump low", last("302_lsh_01_dgsl_tank_level_high") AS "Degasser sump high", last("302_p_05_motive_water_feed_pump_run_fb") AS "Motive water pump" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: Polishing and degassing

panels.description: Run signals as sent by the PLC. CIP, caustic and SMBS run signals are not shown: they are unreliable because of field isolator switches. The MBR scour blower signal is under review. RO HP pump drive is the one drive shared by pumps A and B.

targets.query: SELECT last("201_b_01_aeration_blower_power") AS "Aeration blower", last("202_b_01_mbr_blower_run_fb") AS "MBR scour blower", last("202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_frequency") AS "Permeate pump", last("202_p_02_mbr_backwash_pump_run_fb") AS "Backwash pump", last("301_p_01_ro_mcf_feed_pump_run_fb") AS "RO feed pump", last("301_p_05_antiscalant_dosing_pump_run_fb") AS "Antiscalant dosing", last("501_p_01_dewatering_feed_pump_run_fb") AS "Dewatering feed pump" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m
SELECT last("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_power") AS "RO HP pump drive" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m
SELECT last("302_p_0102_ro_hp_pump_ab_power") AS "RO HP pump drive" FROM "plc" WHERE time > now() - 5m

panels.title: Pumps and blowers

panels.description: Average TMP while the permeate pump runs. Legend shows the average for the period. Hourly averages.

targets.query: SELECT mean("202_calc_mbr_tmp") AS "TMP" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "202_p_01_mbr_permeate_pump_frequency" > 0 GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: MBR TMP · while permeating

panels.description: RO permeate flow while the high-pressure pump runs. Hourly averages.

targets.query: SELECT mean("302_fit_02_ro_permeate_flow") AS "Permeate flow" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND ("302_p_01_ro_hp_pump_a_power" > 1 OR "302_p_0102_ro_hp_pump_ab_power" > 1) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: RO permeate flow · while running

panels.description: Plant energy per m³ of inlet flow for each day (IST). Days with a meter reset (above 50 kWh/m³) are left out.

targets.query: SELECT spread("900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total") / spread("100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer") AS "kWh/m³" FROM "plc" WHERE $timeFilter AND "900_mfm_01_mcc_main_energy_total" > 0 AND "100_fit_01_inlet_flow_totalizer" > 0 GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(none)

panels.title: Specific energy · daily

panels.description: Fresh = readings in the last 5 minutes; Late = last reading 5–15 minutes ago; Stale = nothing for 15 minutes: call Ensaras support.

targets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM "${measurement}" WHERE time > now() - 15m
